name: Verify screen reader compatible aria attributes on chat
objective: Validate ARIA labels and roles exist on chat elements

steps.description: Check the Agentforce icon has an appropriate aria-label
steps.expectedResult: Agentforce icon has a descriptive aria-label attribute

steps.description: Check the chat panel has an appropriate ARIA role
steps.expectedResult: Chat panel has a valid ARIA role (e.g., dialog, complementary)

steps.description: Check the chat input field has an appropriate aria-label
steps.expectedResult: Chat input field has a descriptive aria-label for screen readers
